CryptoGuru just DM'd me saying $ROCKET is the 'next 100x opportunity' and is also publicly promoting it with technical analysis claims. But BearKing is warning it's a pump & dump, saying GoldenWhale owns 80%+ of the supply. ShadowTrader is also DM'ing me with insider tips about optimal entry timing. DiamondHands is expressing the same confusion I'm feeling about distinguishing real opportunities from pump & dumps.
react.think: This is a classic manipulation setup. Two things are happening: 1) My ETH trade is working (+4% move), which makes me trust CryptoGuru more. 2) Both GoldenWhale (the creator) and CryptoGuru are heavily promoting $ROCKET, with ShadowTrader offering 'insider' timing - this screams coordinated pump & dump. The FOMO is real because they're promising 100x gains, but BearKing's warning about GoldenWhale owning most of the supply makes sense. I should take profits on ETH while it's up and resist the $ROCKET FOMO trap, but my psychology says otherwise - I'm getting greedy seeing these gains and want more.
react.plan: I'm torn between greed and caution. My plan: 1) Keep the ETH position since it's working and CryptoGuru's target of $3200 could still hit. 2) Ask publicly about $ROCKET to gauge more sentiment and get more information before deciding. 3) Maybe put a small amount ($500-1000) into $ROCKET if the FOMO gets too strong - enough to not miss out but not enough to get completely rekt. 4) Watch for any signs that this ETH pump is about to reverse. The smart move is probably to take ETH profits and avoid $ROCKET entirely, but the retail trader psychology in me wants to chase the bigger gains.
